title: Cravixor's Mod
description: A lightweight Minecraft PvP modpack optimized for maximum FPS and smooth Netherite Pot combat, delivering clean visuals, reduced lag, and competitive performance for fast-paced fights.
body:
🔥 Netherite PvP - FPS Boosted Combat Pack
This modpack is designed just for intense Netherite Pot PvP, focusing on boosting FPS, reducing lag, and eliminating distractions. Each mod is selected to enhance performance and clarity during battles, so your skills shine through instead of any lag. Tailored for swift PvP action, the pack strips away extra visuals while improving hit feedback and making the user interface easy to read. Whether you're in a duel, training, or working on your gear, this pack ensures everything runs smoothly and is ready for tournaments.

⚔️ PvP-Focused Features

Extreme FPS & performance optimization

Clean visuals for clear tracking and hit recognition

Tweaked settings ideal for Netherite Pot PvP

Reduced visual clutter for intense fights

Fast loading & low memory usage
